title: Turán type inequalities for oscillatory special functions
summary: In this paper our aim is to prove a conjecture of Á. Baricz on Bessel functions of the first kind, which improves the classical Turán type inequality for Bessel functions of the first kind proved by O. Szász. The idea is to consider the normalized Turán expression for Bessel functions of the first kind and to show that between two consecutive zeros of the Bessel functions of the first kind the branch of this normalized Turán expression has a local minimum, and the minimum values form a strictly increasing convergent sequence, whose terms are strictly decreasing with respect to the order.…
